title: What It Looks Like When Work Is Worship and Still a Job
caption:
Colossians 3:23. Whatever you do, work at it with your whole heart, as working for the Lord, not for men. Your manager isn't who you're actually clocking in for.

The Lord sees the spreadsheet nobody checks and the shift nobody thanks you for. Excellence isn't about the task. It's about who's watching.

A man who never stops working isn't holy, he's anxious. The Sabbath was a command before it was a suggestion. Build rhythms that trust God with what you didn't finish.

Build hard. Want more. Just hold it open-handed. The work is yours to do. The outcome was always His to give.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #work #discipline
